description: This file contains functions for marshaling Protocol Buffer messages, including handling of various data types such as time.Time, time.Duration, slices, and custom types, for the gogo/protobuf library.

methods.name: makeMessageRefMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for message types, handling size calculation and marshaling with reference to message pointer.

methods.name: makeMessageRefSliceMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for slices of messages, handling size calculation and marshaling, including error handling for nil and required fields.

methods.name: makeCustomPtrMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for custom pointer types, handling size calculation and marshaling.

methods.name: makeCustomMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for custom types, handling size calculation and marshaling.

methods.name: makeTimeMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for *time.Time, converting to protobuf timestamp and marshaling.

methods.name: makeTimePtrMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for *time.Time pointers, handling nil pointers.

methods.name: makeTimeSliceMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for slices of time.Time, marshaling each element.

methods.name: makeTimePtrSliceMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for slices of *time.Time, handling nil elements.

methods.name: makeDurationMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for *time.Duration, converting to protobuf duration.

methods.name: makeDurationPtrMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for *time.Duration pointers, handling nil pointers.

methods.name: makeDurationSliceMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for slices of time.Duration, marshaling each element.

methods.name: makeDurationPtrSliceMarshaler
methods.description: Creates marshaler functions for slices of *time.Duration, handling nil elements.
